SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
POLICE REGIST.
No. D 2137

May 4, 33.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter
No.508 of May 2, regarding a female named Lee Sih Pao
(徐雪寶) the wife of Lee Veng Chu (李文秋), who
absconded with a quantity of jewellery and cash on
April 12, 1933, and to inform you that the matter will
receive attention.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.
Deputy Commissioner (Crime).

General Wen Hung-an,
Chief of the Public Safety Bureau,
Shanghai.

（批：Inspector No... 5/5/33）

逕复者准五月二日法字
第五〇八号大函以李文秋
之妻徐雪宝一名於本年
四月十二日捲取金飾現
洋等逃逸無踪請为查
緝由准此現已飭屬從事
偵緝矣相应函复即希
查照可存此致
上海市公安局局長文

副警務部長 包文
兼刑事處處長

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of Letter from Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.

法 No. 508.                                          May      2,      193 3.

S.M.P. Headquarters,
Shanghai.

Sirs,

        A report has been received by our No. 2 Sub
Station of No. 1 District to the following effect:-

        "Lee Fai Nyuen (李海元), bean-curd shop keeper,
residing at No. 12 Kong Chia Loong, reports that his
son, Lee Veng Chu (李文秋), got married to a girl named
Zee Sih Pao (徐雪寶) in November 1931, and on April
12, 1933, his daughter-in-law on the pretext of going
home for some clothing absconded with the following
jewellery :- 1 pair gold bangles, 1 gold finger ring,
1 gold hair ornament, 1 gold hair pin, 2 gold buttons
and $212.00 in cash. On April 24, the complainant sent
his wife to go to her home to make enquiry when it was
found that she had not returned home at all. It is
requested that every endeavour be made to trace the
whereabouts of the absconded female."

        In view of the foregoing report, apart from
instructing our men to the above effect, I shall be
much obliged if you will be good enough to order your
subordinates to endeavour in tracing the whereabouts
of the absconded female, and favour me with a reply.

                                                Wen Hung En
                                    Chief of Public Safety Bureau
                                                Shanghai.

（批：Information Sheet No. 1160
5 MAY 1933）

上海公共租界警务处
警务处长办公室。

上海市公安局来函译文。

法字第508号。                                          1933年5月2日。

上海公共租界警务处总部，
上海。

先生们：

我局第一区第二分署收到一份报告，内容如下：

“住在孔家弄12号的豆腐店店主李海元（Lee Fai Nyuen）报案称，其子李文秋（Lee Veng Chu）于1931年11月与一名叫徐雪宝（Zee Sih Pao）的女子结婚。1933年4月12日，其儿媳借口回家取衣物，携以下珠宝潜逃：金手镯一副、金戒指一枚、金头饰一件、金发簪一支、金纽扣两枚，以及现金212.00元。4月24日，报案人派其妻子前往女方家中查询，发现她根本未曾回家。恳请尽力追查该潜逃女子的下落。”

鉴于上述报告，除指令我局人员按上述情况办理外，如蒙贵处下令下属尽力追查该潜逃女子的下落，并惠予回复，我将不胜感激。

                                                文鸿恩
                                    上海市公安局局长
                                                上海。

（批注：情报单第1160号
1933年5月5日）
